market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$81k on May 5; $45k requires a ~44% drawdown by Dec 31 2026 — a deep bear scenario. Such drops occur in BTC but typically only after major macro shocks or post-cycle peaks. With 8 months remaining and current uptrend, base rate is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Tail risk from macro recession, regulatory shock, or Iran/geopolitical fallout could trigger broad risk-off
